notes.title: Procedural Houses Update
notes.content:
Hello all!

After quite a long time a new update has at last been completed. This took a lot of work and has improvements in a large variety of areas, so I hope you enjoy.

To start with, as I'd imagine you'd have worked out by now, is the new procedural houses. These are houses that are generated randomly and thus are different each time you play. Each house will have a random exterior and a random set of rooms each joined together. Take a look:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872189/861343174e4900dbf87ff7c8b2a42bbf74bcdbf2.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872189/a409bdcc7998612e3198d16f8baa49550dc020d2.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872189/efbfb7fe52e9e37dca8b32db8205ca49f63cfa0f.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872189/401312fcc7d86b61e25805394463b2d0468a351f.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872189/ed0bf167a8ff40d24e23f08012b9dac2f218fc52.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872189/fceec3cf14a9eccb4981b94db4ac0aea67e18b81.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872189/6a6bd5185950d61a349c7614f4ad29c0be217bd3.png

Another feature that I worked very hard on implementing is one you may not notice, even though this feature took more time and effort than any other to date. I am talking about the networking rewrite. Most of the networking code in the game was from the original game and thus had some issues. Thankfully I have rewritten the entire way the game handles multiplayer which should result in greater stability and less bugs.

As part of this voice chat has been made more consistent, especially with low frame rates or poor connections. You can also now join a server mid game, and you will be loaded into the game. Items now also sync properly in all situations and should be very hard if not impossible to desync. I have also made players drop all their items when they disconnect allowing for a more consistent multiplayer experience, no more having someone disconnect with the ghost trap and soft locking the game.

Unfortunately their are no screenshots to show for those improvements, but here's something I can show:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872189/9ad0875d415abf145a81565dba619208fca681e1.png
There is now a connecting to server screen and if you fail to connect it will handle it gracefully and send you back to the lobby, you can also cancel at anytime. As you can see I had some fun with this one.

Now, definitely the most notable addition is the revamp of the lobby.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872189/de7fddf747a5843661b87711944ce8168b7d04a8.png
As you can see a lot of work went into making the lobby a good experience and making it feel like it belongs in the game.

As you level up you will unlock more and more areas in the lobby and it will evolve, giving you a changing experience as you progress. Here is one such room that will unlock at level 10:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872189/8ec4074fcce7982cfefe12b53c101b3e0b28b25d.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872189/5847e42fc473d4a462b8978aeb1408a64e1be09e.png
Unfortunately, due to the size of the new lobby a loading screen was needed to ensure that no one freezes for long enough to be disconnected from multiplayer, but this should result in a smoother experience anyway so it's not all bad. And on fast drives the loading screen in very quick.

The XP system has not changed but look out for a potential change in the future.

As for standout features there is one last, and highly anticipated one. Namely, rebindable controls. Take a look:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872189/fb077b2162e928d2eb0950b36e79a30af4db70ec.png
Not only can you rebind any of your controls, you can now add as many as you would like, and also bind controllers, this means analogue movement is now supported.


Okay now for some more minor improvements.

There are a heap more pictures that can be randomly in every picture frame:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872189/48d13466771e76e919c8c36fe346190b2c8fd52a.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872189/e5fa813c1338486d44961a081e89d6880dac0c7a.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872189/5042cefc9d1ee39a41ac2c0c0f24c6765183f394.png

The ghost trap model has been remade completely:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872189/6b93e41670e34cf26d7d95e4e1a8e809feef3c88.png

The underlying engine (Godot) has been updated to the latest version, This should mean greater stability, performance, and quality overall. It also improves my ability to develop the game. Directly as a result of this the following changes were made:
- Physics interpolation
- Better physics engine for reliability and performance (Jolt)
and plenty more minor changes in the background.

And finally, performance. Performance has been a growing concern of mind for quite a while. So I bit the bullet and spent a couple weeks optimising everything I could find. Some things I couldn't change without degrading the visuals of the game, so I've put some things behind graphics settings:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872189/20d6805450e32c6c5c2d6dc9a36a0441ea03d5ef.png
So if the game still doesn't run well then have a play around until it runs okay.

Just before I finish up, here are some quick minor changes and bug fixes:

 Ghost now spawns in random spot in house
 Model optimisation was reverted for some broken models
 Fixed server disconnect causing crash
 Fixed dead players colliding incorrectly
 Made player look follow adjacent players within range
 Fix animations and particles displaying on server join
 Increased breaker capacity on all maps
 Fix breaker flicking all switches
 Fix typing E closing the current GUI
 Fix dead players have walking particles
 New ambience for dead players
 Fix ghost camera timer overflow at 100 minutes
 Make username update without clicking enter in text field


Thanks, I hope you all enjoy :)

notes.title: Voice Chat Update
notes.content:
LESSGOOOO!

This is an update I've been personally very excited for.

I've wanted proximity voice chat from the start because sitting in a Discord voice chat and playing just isn't the same as hearing your friend go silent after they've been killed or having people fade into the distance. And let's be honest, it's really hard to play the game when you can't communicate with your teammates.

Unfortunately voice chat is really hard to show in screenshots so I'll show some GUI elements of it. To really see it in action you'll have to play with some friends.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872189/4131583adc0ef334b23cd54d6ea61b53c60da403.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872189/7d4fb94cfb7d6b2506d4d6e331b39cda414b5ad0.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872189/a667ab8e39fbdd5cf57ed1ea606596b68f63c568.png

But adding proximity voice chat isn't the only thing added in this update.

Say hello to the new and improve Eighteenth Street outside:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872189/1e8e8f479e00b1542cc0b4922643c018a3482531.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872189/f92b823eef531ac987083152da7e13576d27d087.png

The houses felt a bit lifeless, so we added some ambience particles:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872189/7dcd7de378c74023d6e510d8d5741de72cd14629.png
See if you can spot them!

Another thing that should help bring the houses to life is the addition of some more paintings! Here is one such example:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872189/1e630c42d1c6c4234b529787ca3eadb0fc218fc6.png

Another environmental change - Depth of field:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872189/0fa8eaecebb4b4cfd3eb042c1f2dc8d6c787b1b1.png
It's super noticeable in the lobby but in game it's much more subtle in the houses.

Something else that you may not notice:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872189/fb0c8809a26b77145681164b094f4a4932596ae4.png
Walking and sprinting particles!

And, something that should have happened ages ago:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872189/587e497e3b3f728b4b622d6cc1bfd0012516a2c8.png
You can see your own shadow!

Anyway that raps up all the changes that I have pictures for. Here are some other changes:
- Fixed player animations
- Fixed spirit box talking when ghost is captured
- Fixed foyer room collider
- Add versioning display to pause menu
- Enable shadows in lobby world
- Fix sanity bugs
- Fixed ghost hunting when only dead players are inside
- Make hallucinations less random and more consistent
- Tweaked environment settings (incl. fog)
- Fixes plates clipping into objects
- More paintings
- Add view bobbing
- Footsteps pitch change when sprinting
- Dead players see each other
- Track captured ghosts
- Fix achievement tracking issue
- Fixed bad FPS causing slow movement
- Optimise models
- Add dropped item particles
- Changed item holding position
- Add grass and bushes and trees to Eighteenth Street
- Add physics TPS config option
- Better localisation system

notes.title: Movement Animations Patch
notes.content: The player models now have animations :)

notes.title: House Experience Update
notes.content:
First off, we have updated our game engine Godot to version 4.3. This means slightly better performance for you and hopefully more stability. However this is primarily an internal change.

But anyway, in terms of more tangible improvements:

The torch light now comes are of your face while you're holding it and doesn't clip through walls!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872189/c818d848e28fd3ae378dd86e9697a913b933b02f.png

As is seen in the screenshot, you no longer have to stand back to ensure you can actually see what you are trying to look at.

Say hello to the new 55 Eighteenth Drive.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872189/77aa7c82947b5b2e1afd0a2ecb1ef1bcd8314dcf.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872189/76f6c98ffa5cec7cbfd145a13a374e0b82a4e949.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872189/afafca63086ef3be329e58677b018dc86de5568e.png

Both the basement and living room have been made much smaller and more manageable. Outside has been given fences to stop you leaving and giving it a much nicer feel.

As for our other house, say hello to the new 18 Jenhill Court.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872189/50bbcdbdf51f6d5541f2b826c95fac2cf4e21e93.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872189/bff419dfbbb63b7061d605933885e12fba1bd0b0.png

As you can see the outside has been majorly revamped with fences, a driveway and a carport to give the outside a better feel.

The next change is my favourite. The outside of houses has always felt a bit dead, uninteresting, so along with the revamped design. There is also weather and ambient noise. It can be either clear, rainy, or stormy. Each weather type has it's own ambience noise, which can also be faintly heard from inside.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872189/eeefd7f96c5a17d23c5983d126a375a38694cdb4.png

It feels amazing in game so be sure to check it out. Try and get every weather type.

One aspect of the game which kind of sucked is dying. There was no good indicator for being dead. So hopefully this new shader improves that aspect of it. Check it out:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872189/f39b3831d05d9807ad83f18d0cb9e6ce53e96b88.png

Another good visual but also mechanical change is to sanity. The sanity change amount has been tweaked, and now you lose sanity both in the light and in the dark. When standing in the light sanity drain is 60% slower. In addition, the ugly old sanity shader where everything goes blurry has been removed in favour of a much better one. Check it out what happens if you somehow manage to get to zero sanity:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872189/8b90eae94e9662dc4b9e467ec926070aa68deb08.png

Another long awaited change is here. Player models! No more capsules as friends.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872189/3c31ddfe46fb7f0d4f73da3d897f8848a5bf7980.png

I can't show you this change with an image, but it is still great nonetheless and deserves to be talked about. A bunch of new sound effects were added, including for:
- Toggling items on/off
- Selecting ghost type on trap
- Placing trap
- Winning
- Losing
- Switching held item

And finally, for our list of major changes. No more frozen games while loading maps. No more failures to join on slower computers. There is now a loading screen for loading maps!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872189/a057d85c5f4cf2b904f60bc9aec2421dd99eb50f.png

There have also been some smaller changes which didn't need an entire paragraph and image, so here they are:
- FOV effects for sprinting
- No more debug messages in release builds
- Optimisations
- Fixed ghost being pushed by players
- Adjust volumes of some sounds

notes.title: Camera Improvements + Important Fixes
notes.content:
We improved the camera! No more will it have that bad looking shader effect which was actually a bug, it now has a GUI and more realistic looking screen. The camera can now also be held to your face by pressing 'E', and is more useful while ghost hunting because it has auto exposure to brighten up the rooms.

We also implemented the following fixes:

 Fixes crucifix not triggering
 Fix ghost getting stuck in multiplayer after one person dies in a death hunt leading to the hunt ending and the game being softlocked
 Fix EMF5 multiplayer desync
 Fix dead players experiencing hallucinations


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872189/1824a3a2fb2f33f183a64a28a16283a01aaccd16.png
